## About
White Glove Express Movers is a moving company based in Spring, TX. We move homes for people around the area and keep our phones open Monday through Saturday.
Customers have given us a 4 star rating across 102 Google reviews. One customer wrote that our crew was "Incredibly kind, quick&professional," and another called the guys "very polite." If you are planning a move, give us a call and tell us what you need.

## Services
- Moving: Moving your household belongings from one home to the next. Call us to talk through what you need.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. We are open Saturday from 8 AM to 6 PM, the same hours as weekdays. We are closed Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We are at 6902 Farm To Market Rd 2920 in Spring, TX 77379.

They instead came out first thing on a Sunday morning which I know is never fun for anybody.  It also turned out that the job itself was more cumbersome than I had originally told them, but they still got it done super quickly and reassured me it was no trouble.  They were incredibly careful with our items, much more careful than I was, and made sure I had everything I needed multiple times.  I was also charged less than what I was quoted when I expected it to be more considering that I ended up asking quite a lot more from them than quoted.
